lens.adaptation: The previous build compressed the search into one visit. Here it takes several nights, because the cost of the search is the point.
lens.irony: A reader already knows what the wine is for. A Recollection will say so, at no charge, whenever you want it.

veteran: The crevice this leads to matters again at chapter 60, long after the wall goes dark.

commands.text: The jar is open on a flat stone. Bamboo, wet, and a cool smell going nowhere.
A wine-loving Gu lives on this mountain. The memory is that specific and no more specific than that.
Five hundred years is a long time for a crevice to keep the same shape.
Nothing on the first night. Nothing on the second.
Fourth night. Something white comes out between the stems, drinks, and goes northeast fast enough to cost essence to follow.
I have seen worse returns on two stones.
